statement: Section 8 follows the lines under the smoothing: the three simple lines persist and the 24 lines coalesced along the tetrahedron edges separate into real lines for type I, giving 27.

answer.text: A smoothing realizes all 27 lines as real.
answer.qualification: The type-I smoothing in Klein’s construction attains the complex upper bound.

source.version: Original Mathematische Annalen 6(1873),551–581; GDZ article scan LOG_0040

scope: Nonsingular real cubic surfaces obtained by smoothing the real four-node cubic in Klein’s construction.
notes:
The paragraph also displays 15,7,3,3 for the other types. No chamber-connectedness result is catalogued from the historical deformation argument in this pass.

Klein explicitly credits Schläfli for the five real-line types. Klein remains cited for the geometric deformation/topological description included in this record.
